62702.description: The dead transformed into vengeful spirits, crossing through a gate to bring calamity to the human world. The delivery man Zhang Zha accidentally entered a haunted graveyard, unleashing a disaster as spirits crossed into the human world. A cast of extraordinary figures became involved. Amid a series of battles and adventures, Zhang grew stronger and a modern martial world story filled with mystery and excitement unfolded.

62703.description: Third season of Bai Lian Cheng Shen.

62704.description: The young human Wang Dong vowed to avenge his parents and joined the Storm Squad, determined to exterminate the Zhage insect species across the solar system. Through hardships, he awakened his Blade Warrior powers, upgraded his armor and skills, and ultimately uncovered the insects' ultimate plot on Earth along with his team. Facing overwhelming swarms, Wang activated his ultimate Blade Warrior form and defeated both human traitors and the insect leader Ying Yuan.

62706.description: In 2145, a hundred years after the "New Humanity Project"—which was intended to fully unlock human potential—triggered a nuclear apocalypse, human survivors built a new social order upon the wastelands. In this world shaped by technology, supernatural powers, and magical arts, the only "complete new human", Jiang Li, awakened from his long slumber to begin his legendary journey.

62707.description:
Orphan Qin Yu was specially admitted to the top cultivation academy, Dongda Martial Academy. Behind the city's calm, a demonic threat quietly approached. Qin Yu vowed to lead his fellow disciples to resist the invading demons.

(Source: Youku)

62708.description:
Shang prince Youshen Bupo rescued Jiang Li, disciple of Taiyi Sect, and the two of them traveled together, adventuring across the vast wilderness. They joined a merchant caravan, encountered heavenly tribulations, faced fierce beasts, defeated bandits, and rescued the heroine… Bound together by fate, the two became embroiled in a great war between the Xia and Shang dynasties.

(Source: Youku, translated)
synonyms: Threads of Fate: A War Untold

62714.description:
The Pure Sea's currents flow from north to south, constantly flowing through this world. People build homes and thrive on the backs of giant beasts. Every wish has its response. The deity known as Fan Ying warns that only by letting your wishes run wild can you reap the rewards of miracles and survive. However, the unchanging rules are about to change, and those who transcend fate will eventually follow the origin of all things.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

62715.description:
The vast sea turns to dust, the thunder and lightning cease, and the mist approaches the earth once again. The shackles of the world are once again unlocked, and a brand new world unveils a mysterious corner...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

62717.description: The seventh season of Wu Dong Qiankun.

62723.description:
The final battle of the Immortal Ancient Era begins. The Willow Deity leads the charge in search of hope, while Shi Hao sends a clone formed from a drop of true blood back through time to end the darkness once and for all. As calamity descends, the Immortal Ancient Era reaches its tragic and heroic finale.

(Source: WeTV)
synonyms: ​完美世界剧场版 第二部

title.english: Perfect World Movie: Ninefold The Burning Sky
title.native: 完美世界剧场版 九劫焚天
title.romaji: Wanmei Shijie Movie: Jiu Jie Fen Tian

62726.description:
During Luo Feng's training on the Primeval Star, he remains calm despite the covetousness and encirclement of alien races. He uses his wisdom and strength to fight back and uphold the dignity of humanity. "I have a blade that can cleave the universe!" That breathtakingly beautiful battle blade accompanies Luo Feng as he slashes his way through the world! The Demon Race, the Mechanical Race, and the Insect Race reappear, forming a three-race alliance. The leaders of the three races, along with 6,000 Universe Venerables, besiege Luo Feng. Luo Feng unleashes the powerful force of "I Am the Universe," annihilating them in one fell swoop.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Note: The events of this movie occur between episodes 134 and 135 of Tunshi Xingkong 4, or episodes 219 and 220 overall.

title.native: 吞噬星空剧场版 决战原始星
title.romaji: Tunshi Xingkong Movie: Juezhan Yuanshi Xing

62727.description:
After the release of the divine artifact Shiva's Wrath, Cangnan City faces an unprecedented crisis. With the Western evil gods lurking in their wake, are the Chinese gods about to awaken? Infused with the power of the twin gods, Lin Qiye joins the Night Watchmen of Cangnan City in fighting against the Western evil gods and defending Cangnan! The Second War of the Gods is about to begin!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Slay The Gods Movie: The Dead of Cangnan

title.native: 斩神之凡尘神域剧场版 沧南之殇
title.romaji: Zhan Shen: Fanchen Shen Yu Movie - Cangnan Zhi Shang

62729.description:
Set against a thousand-year war between the Human Clan and the Demon Clan, the story follows a 13 vs. 13 death match, where seven victories decide life and death.

While the humans secure six early wins through tactical foresight, a hidden scheme emerges—one that could determine the fate of the Sword Qi Great Wall.

(Source: Tencent YouTube Channel)

Note: Relations are provisional until more information is released.

title.native: 剑来院线剧场版 十三之争
title.romaji: Jian Lai Movie: Shisan Zhi Zheng

62730.description: Tang San and Xiao Wu return to the collapsed Slaughter City, now devastated by the Snow Swan Kiss. They face relentless pursuit from the mutated Slaughter King, only to be saved by a mysterious girl whose rescue conceals dark secrets. Together, Tang San and Xiao Wu must uncover the truth behind Slaughter City's corruption.

62734.description:
Its Spiritual Realms are bizarre and full of twists. After a mysterious black card turns him into a Night Wandering Deity, protagonist Zhang Yuanqing is pulled into a conspiracy-laden struggle between two rival camps of justice and evil.

(Source: WeTV)

62738.description:
The sudden crisis brought the earth directly into the OL era, and all mankind was under the influence of mysterious forces. Everyone became a level-one newbie. In this cruel dog-eat-dog world, the high school student Ye Hao could only rise to level three. When he was about to die, he accidentally triggered the king's account upgrade system, can Ye Hao become the strongest king?

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: A Beginner with the Mightiest Account
It Starts with a Kingpin Account
There is a King Account at the Start
Start to Have the King Account

title.romaji: Kaiju Jiu You Wang Zhe Zhanghao

62739.description:
It tells the story of the heroine Tao Mengyan who returned to the mysterious village of Zangling in her dream to find the truth in order to resolve her nightmare. The village still retains the strange custom of worshiping "paper brides". Tao Mengyan, who was chosen as the "paper bride", experienced a life-and-death experience in Zangling Village, and finally solved the mystery of her past life and learned the thousand-year-old historical truth of the "Zangzun" belief in Zangling Village.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

62743.description:
After being confined to Qingshan Mental Hospital, the gifted young man Chen Ji kills the enemy who killed his parents. He then accidentally travels back in time to the ancient world and becomes an apprentice at the Ning Dynasty Medical Clinic. Involved in a case involving the Secret Service, he becomes a non-staff member of the agency, only to discover he's also a spy for the enemy nation. The story revolves around this dual identity. Trapped in the maelstrom of power, Chen Ji secretly fights for survival, using modern knowledge to deconstruct spiritual cultivation systems and maneuvering to overturn the chessboard. Ultimately, he transforms from pawn to master, wielding the Qingshan Mountains as his blade, vowing to shatter the hypocrisy of heaven!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

62744.description:
A perpetual night of catastrophe, terror descends, and strange phenomena abound! A young man, Wang Ye, is inexplicably chosen by the "Mysterious Post Office" to serve as a "ghost messenger," awakening his special powers and repeatedly embroiling himself in dangerous and paranormal phenomena. Witness how Wang Ye pushes the envelope, dispelling the mysteries and igniting the flames of humanity's survival amidst the terrifying darkness.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Qing Jiao Wo Gui Chai Da Ren

62746.description:
"My name is Yang Jian, and by the time you read this, I'll be dead."

Ordinary student Yang Jian is caught up in a bizarre invasion, acquiring parchment from the future and a mysterious eye, becoming a ghost wielder. Yang Jian and his classmates escape the campus, but the crisis is just beginning. In this sinister world, the human world is a prison. The price of peering into darkness is eternal loss amidst endless wonder.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

62751.description:
Li Nianfan transmigrated into the world of immortal cultivation with a mortal body. After learning that he had no talent for cultivation, he settled down to live an ordinary life. But only to find...

The dog he adopted watched his writing and painting, and became the demon lord that ruled half the world. The tree he planted in the backyard listened to him play and sing, and grew into the world tree that held up the bridge between heaven and earth. A casual conversation enlightened a passing traveler to become the immortal sage that defined the era...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

62753.description:
I was reborn as a villainous daughter in a reverse harem otome game.

After being sick with a high fever at the age of 10, Pia Rockwell suddenly remembered her past life as a university student in Japan. But far from going down the villainess route, all this super timid girl wants is to finally use her knowledge from when she was a grad student studying to get her doctorate in paleontology. Her ultimate goal is to become a commoner, excavate fossils, build a museum and then become a curator.

So in order to escape the villainess route and avoid being deported by her fiancé during the graduation ball, Pia decides to avoid the upcoming hurt and heartache and asks to break off her engagement to Rufus, the Prime Minister's son.

But will her cunning fiancé let her go that easily?

title.english: Even Though I'm a Super Timid Noble Girl, I Accepted the Bet From My Cunning Fiancé
title.native: 弱気MAX令嬢なのに、辣腕婚約者様の賭けに乗ってしまった
title.romaji: Yowaki MAX Reijou Nano ni, Ratsuwan Konyakusha-sama no Kake ni Notte Shimatta

62777.description:
"The moment the first gleam of sunlight trickled in gently stirring the folds of a shallow sleep—that was when the graffiti appeared..."

Second installment in the Bungaku Video series, a collaborative project between contemporary Japanese literature and animation.

Notes:
- Based on the poem Rakugaki written by Makoto Takayanagi in 1999, included in the 2001 novel Yumeyume Waseruru Nakare.
- Premiered at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival on June 10, 2025, as a part of the official selection in the Off-Limits category, where it also won the Off-Limits Award.

62781.description: A young but experienced Taoist is sent to the city by his master to hunt ghosts. There, he finds himself unwittingly involved in a series of strange events and has to face various challenges.

62786.description:
The Ye family was suddenly massacred—Ye Beichen's parents and brothers were slaughtered, and he himself was ruthlessly thrown into the moat, clinging to life by a thread. Rescued by his senior sister, he was taken to Kunlun Mountain, where he spent five grueling years mastering martial arts. Five years later, he returned in full force, armed with the peerless skills taught by 99 invincible masters. Back in the mortal world, when faced with old enemies and powerful factions, Ye Beichen showed no fear. With extraordinary martial prowess and overwhelming strength, he unleashed chaos across the city, carving a path of revenge and dominance—turning the tables and crushing all who once sought his downfall.

(Source: Youku, translated)

title.native: 徒儿你无敌了下山去吧
title.romaji: Tuer Ni Wudile Xiashan Qu Ba

62789.description:
In the darkest moment of Celestial Realm, the crippled youth Gu An seized the power of an ancient god amid life-or-death peril. Wielding infinite spiritual energy and a mortal blade, he destroyed evildoers, avenged deep grudges, and struck down the heavens.

(Source: Youku)

62790.description:
In an out-of-control world, survivors faced a thrilling and perilous apocalyptic battlefield.

(Source: Youku, translated)

62791.description:
2283, in a post-nuclear wasteland, Fortress City 021 was controlled by Ark Corporation. Their so-called "Savior Guardians" appeared to protect humanity but secretly conducted human experiments using X chips and manipulated public opinion. Young Han Che witnessed his brother's murder by the false Guardians and unexpectedly awakened the "1307 Source System" within him, gaining superpowers. He joined the Yebushou organization, rebuilt by Guan Shanhu, and fought alongside hacker Tian Xin and engineer Kang Di. Yebushou infiltrated Ark training camps and Ghost Island Prison, exposing a plot to create a superpowered army using experiments and mutants. As Han Che unlocked new abilities and faced formidable enemies like Emperor Angel and Divine-Eye Immortal, he embarked on a path of vengeance, truth, and salvation. However, the hidden AI "Lefu" was plotting to control all human consciousness.

(Source: Youku)

62794.description:
To resist invasions from other worlds, the Heavenly Great Sage founded Tianguan Academy. Every year, the Academy would recruit new students—but in the end, only nine could become the official Heavenly Officers. Gu Tian, a young soccer player, accidentally awakened his hidden power while saving someone on the field. Invited by his senior Xia Zhi, he boarded Subway Line 36 to Tianguan Academy. With the world's finest teachers, strict assessments, and a brutal elimination system, the Academy pushes its students to the limit. By a stroke of fortune, Gu Tian became the 81st student to pass the entrance trial. Under the guidance of celestial masters, he studied spells and divine decrees, honed his combat skills against powerful rivals, and strode forward step by step toward the ultimate goal of becoming one of the Nines.

(Source: Youku, translated)
